Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CNCI Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post at CNCI?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post at CNCI is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Data Entry Operator position, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institute and have a typing speed of 8000 Key depressions per hour on a computer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Entry Operator post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 12,000 per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post at the Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute (CNCI).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the CNCI Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Data Entry Operator recruitment at CNCI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Entry Operator role will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by a Test.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the CNCI office in Kolkata, West Bengal, with the pincode 700160.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Data Entry Operator position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
